snippet.title: LIGHT UP THE TOWN | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419910/Light_Up_The_Town/

Light Up The Town is a cozy, casual holiday game for all ages. Play as Bean, a precocious young ferret, and explore the town of Bellflower, Colorado as you hang up festive string lights around to spread holiday cheer. Click to throw a light or decoration; the only limit is your imagination.

Quick note on our other game, Heartshot: We're still working on it! We've had to make some major structural changes to the game, and have been working on Light Up the Town while we fix everything up. More updates coming soon!
